text:
GTP::forward
Description
Forwards GTP message to peer flow.
Syntax
GTP
::
forward
MESSAGE
Examples
when
GTP_SIGNALLING_INGRESS
{
set
t2
[
GTP
::
new
2
10
]
GTP
::
forward
$t2
}
